flavours.name: Cheesecake and Chill
flavours.note: Peanut cheesecake richness, then caramel and cocoa-biscuit depth.

pairs.why: Salted tropical fruit lifts peanut cheesecake.
Floral coconut is a genuinely creamy bridge.
Sharp, bitter citrus resets the whole scoop.
Espresso counters caramel and echoes the biscuit.

flavours.name: Chocolate Deluxe
flavours.note: A maximal dark-chocolate stack with fudge and cake weight.

pairs.why: Essential bitter-citrus relief for maximum chocolate.
Roasted hazelnut bridges into the dark cocoa.
The strongest high-acid tropical contrast.
A clean dairy contrast that keeps chocolate central.

flavours.name: Fairy Bread
flavours.note: Buttery toast and playful sugar crunch; nostalgic and moderately rich.

pairs.why: Fresh strawberry creates a jam-on-toast effect.
Dark cocoa gives buttered toast more depth.
Tangy berry adds a softer jammy lift.
High-acid fruit stops nostalgia becoming too sweet.

flavours.name: Friend Chip Goals
flavours.note: Toasted cookie, milk chocolate and doughy butter richness.

pairs.why: Citrus is the cleanest reset for cookie dough.
Roast and bitterness counter milk chocolate.
Fresh berry lightens toasted cookie.
Yoghurt tang offers a softer berry contrast.

flavours.name: Macadamia Praline
flavours.note: Mellow dairy cream layered with roasted macadamia and praline.

pairs.why: Salted mango lifts buttery macadamia.
Clean fruit against creamy nut.
A roasted bridge with a drier finish.
Bitter citrus resets praline sweetness.

flavours.name: Mango Pancake
flavours.note: Ripe mango, soft cream and gentle pancake crunch.

pairs.why: A fragrant pandan-mango echo.
Creamy coconut and floral lychee extend the tropical side.
Roasted macadamia gives soft mango structure.
Lean dark cocoa is the strongest counterpoint.

flavours.name: Super Choc Flan
flavours.note: Chocolate custard rounded with deep milk caramel.

pairs.why: Bitter citrus resets chocolate custard and caramel.
Espresso bitterness gives the flan a drier finish.
A smooth roasted bridge into chocolate.
High-acid tropical fruit supplies maximum contrast.

flavours.name: Super Dulce Tiramisu
flavours.note: Caramel-led tiramisu and soft biscuit - dense, creamy and lingering.

pairs.why: A decisive citrus reset for caramel tiramisu.
Roasted nut links naturally to biscuit and caramel.
Tangy berry yoghurt lightens the custard.
Clean dark cocoa gives depth without more dairy.

flavours.name: The Maltster
flavours.note: Malted cocoa and cheesecake - dense, rounded and low-acid.

pairs.why: Espresso extends malt and dries the finish.
Sharp citrus cuts dense malt cheesecake.
A simple dairy bridge that keeps malt central.
Dark cocoa deepens malt without adding more cream.

flavours.name: Twixed
flavours.note: Milk chocolate, caramel and shortbread in a compact, very sweet scoop.

pairs.why: Espresso counters caramel and shortbread.
Citrus gives the strongest reset.
Fresh berry adds a lighter dessert contrast.
A fully indulgent chocolate-nut bridge.
